question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 20 days and B can do the same job in 15 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Total Work** be LCM of 20, 15, and 3 = **60 units**.

Efficiency of **A** = 60 ÷ 20 = 3; Efficiency of **B** = 60 ÷ 15 = 4.

Efficiency of **A + B + C** = 60 ÷ 3 = 20.

Efficiency of **C** = 20 − (3 + 4) = 13.

Time taken by **C** = 60 ÷ 13 = 4(8/13) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4(8/13) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** A = 20 days, B = 15 days, A + B + C = 3 days.

**Formula Used:** 1/A + 1/B + 1/C = 1/Total Time

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 A 20 60 3 
 B 15 4 
 A+B+C 3 20 

⇒ Total Efficiency (A+B+C) = 20 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = (A+B+C) − A − B

⇒ Efficiency of C = 20 − 3 − 4 = 13 units/day

⇒ Time for C = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 13 = 4(8/13) days

**∴ The correct answer is 4(8/13) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task. Total Work = Efficiency × Time.

Combined Work Formula

If two people work together, their combined efficiency is the sum of their individual efficiencies: 1/Tₜₒₜₐₗ = 1/T₁ + 1/T₂.

Work & Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the work done or the ratio of efficiencies when the duration of work is the same.</p
